title: Pure Gusto
summary: Gusto cards only, with generic Links and staples. Gusto is a WIND Synchro deck whose monsters float into the next one from the Deck. The 2021 cards lead. Gusto Vedir mills a Gusto and summons another from the hand, and summons itself whenever a face-up Gusto is destroyed in battle or sent to the GY. Daigusto Laplampilica summons a Gusto from the hand and one from the Deck, then Synchro Summons a second Gusto Synchro with them. Tailwind of Gusto protects a Gusto, summons another from the Deck, and searches a Gusto Spell/Trap from the GY. Gusto Griffin summons a Gusto from the Deck when discarded, and Pilica revives a WIND Tuner. Musto negates a monster's effects and Daigusto Sphreez recovers a Gusto card. Pilica and Laplampilica lock you to WIND summons, so the Extra Deck leans on Gusto Synchros.
